newsitem.title: UK: Rank lifted by speculation about new CEO.
newsitem.headline: Rank lifted by speculation about new CEO.

text.p: Shares in Rank Group Plc rose on Thursday amid press talk that Bass chief executive Ian Napier would join the UK leisure giant.
By 1013 GMT Rank shares were up 6-1/2p to 377-1/2p, retreating from the day's high at 382p.
The Guardian newspaper said on Thursday Napier was set to quit Bass and join Rank.
But industry sources said Napiers' exit was unlikely.
"The market reacted positively on (the press report)", one trader said.
But some dealers said the stock was due for an upward correction anyway.
"It's possible that this speculation lifted the stock but I think the recent drop was overdone", another trader said.
Most recently Rank was said to be bidding for First Leisure Plc.
